decision_conditions:
<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The
proposal is therefore <font face="Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">not</span></font> a lawful development.&nbsp;</span></p>

<p> <span style="line-height: 115%;">It has not been demonstrated within the submitted plans that the materials used in any exterior work will be of a similar appearance to those used in the construction of the exterior of the dwellinghouse. The proposal would therefore not be within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B.2(a) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).</span></p>

<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">Due to the design and siting of the proposed dormer sited within the roofslope of the outrigger, the edge closest to the original eaves would be less than 0.2 metres from the eaves of the original main roof. The proposal would therefore not be within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B.2(b)(i)(bb) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">It has not been demonstrated within the submitted plans that the proposed rooflights would not protrude more than 0.15 metres beyond the plane of the slope of the original roof when measured from the perpendicular with the external surface of the original roof. The proposal would therefore not be within the tolerances of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class C.1(b) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).</p>
description: Certificate of Lawful Proposed Development: Rear dormer and 2no. rooflights to the front.
